rules_sent_back.instruction: When The description says that a user presses a control in an application, that readings are then automatically obtained from connected equipment, and that the obtained readings are presented back to the user as a separate later step.: Model the automatic retrieval of readings from the equipment as its own bpmn:serviceTask placed after the user's triggering action. Model the presentation of the retrieved readings to the user as a separate following task. Do not merge the trigger, the retrieval and the presentation into one task.
rules_sent_back.situation: The description says that a user presses a control in an application, that readings are then automatically obtained from connected equipment, and that the obtained readings are presented back to the user as a separate later step.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a user enters or selects several separate items in one clause, joined by commas or 'and', and each item needs its own input or choice: Model each listed item as its own user task, placed in sequence in the order the description gives them. Do not merge the items into one task, and do not drop any listed item.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a user enters several separate identifying items in one clause, joined by 'and' or commas, before a process can begin, and each item needs its own input

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says the software system itself presents information it has obtained (such as readings from connected equipment) to the user, and no person performs the presentation step: Model the system's presentation of the obtained information as a bpmn:serviceTask placed after the step that obtains the information. Do not model it as a generic bpmn:task, which leaves the execution mode unspecified although the description states who performs it, and do not model it as a bpmn:userTask, which is for human work the person performs with software.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says the software system itself presents information it has obtained (such as readings from connected equipment) to the user, and no person performs the presentation step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a person enters or inputs a value, and names the item with a prepositional noun phrase (for example 'the type of the X' or 'the number of the X'): Label the user task with the verb and the description's own noun phrase, keeping its word order and prepositions (for example 'Enter ... of ...'). Do not recombine the phrase into a compound noun or reorder it, and do not drop the preposition-linked part.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a person enters or inputs a value, and names the item with a prepositional noun phrase (for example 'the type of the X' or 'the number of the X')
